item.title: Build 699
item.description:
• A follow-up meeting, drafted for you. When a meeting ends with people agreeing to meet again, the note shows a drafted invite above the summary: a title, a day and time, a short description and who to ask. Review and send opens a sheet where you can change all of it, including the guests (add anyone Mayfly has met, or type an address, and remove anyone). Nothing is sent until you press the button on that sheet, and the button says how many people will be emailed. Dismiss it and it stays dismissed, even if you summarise the note again.
  • Send it from Mayfly, or finish it in Google Calendar. With Google Calendar connected in Settings, Calendars, the sheet creates the event and Google emails the guests, with a Meet link if you want one. Without it, the same button opens Google Calendar's own event editor with everything filled in, and you save it there. Connecting needs the Google Calendar API turned on in the Google Cloud project behind your Mail client, and its calendar scope added to the consent screen. Until then Google's own message shows in the sheet and the other route still works.
  • Where the draft comes from. The day and time are the ones said. When no time was, it is the first free half hour that day in your own calendars, between 09:30 and 16:30, and the note says so. Nothing is drafted when somebody else said they would send the invite, when the next occurrence of a regular meeting is already in your calendar, or when the date has passed. A guest the meeting named but Mayfly cannot match to one person is listed as needing an email, and is not invited until you give one. Turn the whole thing off in Settings, Calendars, Suggest follow-up meetings. A note kept out of AI never gets one.
  • Summaries are told the weekday. The date the summary works from now includes the day of the week, so "next Tuesday" and "by Friday" resolve against the right day.
  • A draft for a todo that says you will send something. Hover over a todo like "Send the estimates spreadsheet to Emma" or "Email Mark about the changes, cc Richard" and an envelope button appears (a # for Slack). It opens a sheet with the message already written from the meeting summary or message the todo came from: who it is for, a subject, and the body, in your voice and without anything that was not said. Where something is missing, such as the attachment, it leaves a [short placeholder] for you to fill in. Change what you like, then Open in Gmail opens a compose window with it filled in; for Slack the message is copied, and the channel opened when Mayfly knows it. Mayfly never sends anything and does not tick the todo. A name that matches nobody, or more than one person, is shown as needing an email and is left out of the compose window until you give one. The draft is kept, so opening it again costs nothing, and Redraft writes a new one. Only your own todos get the button, and never one from a note kept out of AI. Summarising a note again replaces its todos, and their drafts with them.
  • Your projects as a folder Claude Code can read. File, Export Project Context writes each project's brief, its log (one file per decision, open question or milestone) and its links as Markdown, with a CLAUDE.md at the top saying how to read it. Point Claude Code at the folder and it starts from what Mayfly already knows about the project. Notes, transcripts and summaries are not included, and nothing from a note kept out of AI is. The folder is a copy: editing the files changes nothing in Mayfly. Choose an empty folder the first time; Mayfly will not write into a folder it did not make.
  • The folder, from Settings. Settings, Projects, Context folder shows where it is, opens it, and lists each project in it with what it holds. Click a project to open its folder in Finder. Export again brings everything up to date and keeps any files you added beside Mayfly's.
